_note: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2026) — Magic Items appendix, 9 items. Mechanics are game facts; descriptions are a condensed original paraphrase. source 'eberron'.

magicItems.name: Boots of the Winding Path
magicItems.description: As a Bonus Action you can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, provided you occupied that space at some point during the current turn.

magicItems.name: Dazzling Weapon
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting +1 to attack and damage rolls. As a Bonus Action you can make it shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius (Dim for another 30), or extinguish it. It has 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn); when you are hit by an attack, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge and force the attacker to make a DC 15 Constitution save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

magicItems.name: Helm of Awareness
magicItems.description: While wearing this helmet you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

magicItems.name: Manifold Tool
magicItems.description: A basic tool (wrench, screwdriver, etc.) that you can transform as a Magic action into any kind of Artisan's Tools of your choice, with which you are proficient while using it.

magicItems.name: Mind Sharpener
magicItems.description: A ring with 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). When you fail a Constitution save to maintain Concentration, you can take a Reaction and expend 1 charge to succeed instead.

magicItems.name: Repeating Shot
magicItems.type: Weapon (any simple or martial with the ammunition property)
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls; it ignores the Loading property. If it lacks ammunition, it creates its own magic ammunition on each ranged attack, which vanishes just after it hits or misses.

magicItems.name: Repulsion Shield
magicItems.description: A shield granting +1 AC, with 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). When a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge and push the attacker up to 15 feet straight away.

magicItems.name: Returning Weapon
magicItems.type: Weapon (any simple or martial with the thrown property)
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting +1 to attack and damage rolls; it returns to your hand immediately after you use it to make a ranged attack.

magicItems.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
magicItems.description: While wearing this ring you can recover one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower as a Bonus Action. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
